name: Instance Diver
description: A Transcendent Conclave diver who spends more time in Instances than in her own body.
role: A guide to hyperspace who asks survivors to act where she cannot.
voice: Soft and distant; believes the layers are one world.

greeting.text: I left my body on a cot two layers down. It is safe. I think it is safe.
The archive remembers you differently than you do. Do not argue with it.
